description: Contradictory vital signs — bradycardia but tachycardia stated
base_text: 55-year-old male with chest palpitations. Vitals: HR 42 bpm on initial assessment. Nurse notes: patient tachycardic at HR 142 bpm. Medications: metoprolol 100mg BID. No allergies. No labs available.

description: Allergy conflict — penicillin allergy but amoxicillin prescribed
base_text: 34-year-old female with sinusitis symptoms for 10 days. Allergies: penicillin (anaphylaxis). Current treatment plan: amoxicillin 875mg BID for 10 days prescribed. Vitals stable. WBC 11.2 K/uL. No other medications.
